name: Doulos

phase_0.boundary_condition: The legal and ontological status of the subject within a hierarchy of ownership.

VINIT.justification: The state of the individual before legal categorization or the imposition of status.

TANCH.justification: The terminal authority that defines the limits and purpose of the subject.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation of energy into external value for the master.

AREV.justification: The return of the subject to a state of readiness for further service.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of labor tasks into a coherent life of duty.

IMSCRIB.justification: The specific identity assigned to the subject within the household structure.

FSPLIT.justification: A single directive that branches into the possibility of obedience or disobedience.

FFUSE.justification: The reconciliation of the action taken back into the singular record of the subject.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative execution of the command.

EVALF.justification: The failure to execute the command.

ENGAGR.justification: The state of a subject who is legally bound but functionally autonomous.

IFIX.justification: The permanent physical or legal mark of ownership that cannot be erased.

phase_3.void_description: The unassigned individual outside the household or legal framework.
phase_3.true_description: The faithful servant who fulfills the requirements of the law.
phase_3.false_description: The fugitive or rebel who denies the established hierarchy.
phase_3.both_description: The steward who exercises authority while remaining under authority.

steps.domain_action: The subject emerges from the state of nature into the social sphere.
The subject receives a name and a place within the household.
The legal contract or physical mark establishes permanent ownership.
The master issues a specific command to the subject.
The subject chooses the path of obedience to the command.
The subject performs the labor required by the command.
The labor is completed and the subject returns to the master.
The completion of one task leads to the assignment of the next.
The master issues a second command involving a choice of method.
The subject fails to meet the specific requirements of the command.
The subject undergoes correction to return to a state of utility.
The correction is finalized and the subject is reintegrated.
The subject is promoted to a steward holding both power and debt.
The master confirms the final status of the subject at the end of service.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The legal code and household rules that translate commands into expected behaviors.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Verbal directives and physical gestures between the master and the subject.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The ledger of debts, services rendered, and punishments administered.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The daily cycle of the sun and the seasonal needs of the estate.
phase_5.alfs_store: The foundational myth or social contract that justifies the hierarchy.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The physical caloric energy and time of the subject.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A state of potential labor and unfulfilled commands.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of realized value and updated legal standing.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy expended by the subject is converted into the maintenance of the household structure.
